title: Mars Walk Guardian — HiRISE local terrain grid
status: Measured elevation crop verified for valid pixels; roughness derived; slip risk and blocked simulated. Site suitability and target geology remain provisional.

coordinate_system.horizontal: Equirectangular, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude; local spherical radius 3396.19 km

grid.crop_bounds_classification: Derived from DTM map projection and pixel indices
grid.nodata_handling: MISSING_CONSTANT 16#FF7FFFFB# and values outside VALID_MINIMUM / VALID_MAXIMUM are marked valid=false and elevation_m blank; zero nodata cells in this crop; roughness is blank for the outer two-cell border because the full 5x5 neighborhood is unavailable

base.name: Simulated Gale Base candidate
base.classification: Coordinate selected by derived low-slope ranking on measured DTM; base itself is Simulated

target.name: Sol 4621 boxwork-reference science-target candidate
target.classification: Assumed candidate tied to supplied waypoint; exact ridge/formation at this coordinate not confirmed

source_products.format: PDS3 IMG; 32-bit IEEE PC_REAL; little-endian; OFFSET 0; SCALING_FACTOR 1; elevation values meters

source_products.classification: Measured metadata only; ortho pixels were not resampled into this grid

derived: roughness_m_5x5_sd: standard deviation of 5x5 DTM elevations
base candidate ranking by 5x5 finite-difference slope
longitude_deg_east and latitude_deg_planetocentric from DTM map projection and pixel indices
valid from DTM missing-value and valid-range checks
assumed: target is a science-target candidate associated with the supplied Sol 4621 waypoint
simulation area centered on Sol 4621 waypoint
simulated: blocked fixed false placeholder; not an obstacle clearance assessment

notes: All 40,401 cells in crop contain valid DTM elevation pixels.
Base and target cells both valid and within the same continuous 201x201 crop.
DTM and ortho labels share Equirectangular projection, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, same nominal geographic bounds; ortho resolution differs, no resampling performed.
Base is lowest 5x5 mean-slope candidate among cells 79–81 m from target waypoint; low slope is derived, not a guarantee of rover safety.
Science-target geology at the exact target cell is not classified; it is a waypoint-linked candidate only.
Crop is an educational rover-routing input, not flight-qualified terrain data or a guaranteed safe route.
